rule: Items of the 12 sets that are (1) outside the sealed 20% holdout (common.is_holdout), (2) scored in the Sage 2 rc9 read of 28 Oct 2026, and (3) single-window: the 25 Oct 2026 Sage 2 reference read needed one call for the document. Split: eval = int(sha1(item id), 16) % 2 == 1, fit = the rest. Sage 2's abstention thresholds were fitted on `fit`; headline numbers use `eval`.
